select * from eds.eds_hash_log_tbl where file_name like '%did_%'

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG
,JTAR_FLG 
)

	SELECT 
	BANK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,PRODUCT_GROUP
	,PRODUCT_TYPE
	,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
	,FILE_NAME
	,1 AS JSRC_FLG
	,0 AS JTAR_FLG
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING
	WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG
,JTAR_FLG 
)
	SELECT
	BANK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,PRODUCT_GROUP
	,PRODUCT_TYPE
	,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
	,FILE_NAME
	,0 AS JSRC_FLG
	,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
	FROM EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING CC
	WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG_CNT
,JTAR_FLG_CNT
,FILE_DATE
)

	SELECT 
	BANK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,PRODUCT_GROUP
	,PRODUCT_TYPE
	,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
	,FILE_NAME
	,JSRC_FLG_CNT
	,JTAR_FLG_CNT
	,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
	FROM 
		(
		SELECT
		BANK_CODE
		,SOURCE_CODE
		,PRODUCT_GROUP
		,PRODUCT_TYPE
		,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
		,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
		,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT
		,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
		FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
			GROUP BY 
			BANK_CODE
			,SOURCE_CODE
			,PRODUCT_GROUP
			,PRODUCT_TYPE
			,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
			HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
		) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.BANK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SOURCE_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOURCE_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.PRODUCT_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PRODUCT_TYPE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,SCD_START_DATE
,SCD_END_DATE
,ISACTIVE
,ISLATEST
,BNK_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
)
	SELECT
	BANK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,PRODUCT_GROUP
	,PRODUCT_TYPE
	,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
	,SRC.FILE_DATE
	,'9999-12-31'
	,1
	,1
	,SRC.BANK_CODE
	,SRC.FILE_NAME
	,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC SRC
	WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1




WITH CTE1 AS(
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, 
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM 
  FROM 
    d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING 
  WHERE 
    H = 'D' 
  GROUP BY 
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM
), 
CTE2 AS (
  SELECT 
    REPLACE(H, 'F-', '') COUNT_SRC, 
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM 
  FROM 
   SELECT * FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING 
  WHERE 
    H <> 'D'
), 
CTE12 as (
  SELECT 
    COUNT_SRC, 
    COUNT_TGT, 
    A.FILE_NAME, 
    A.INSERT_DTTM, 
    CONVERT(
      DATE, 
      (
        left(
          right(A.FILE_NAME, 12), 
          8
        )
      )
    ) DATE 
  FROM 
    CTE1 A 
    JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME 
    AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
) INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] 
SELECT 
  FILE_NAME, 
  DATE, 
  insert_dttm, 
  REPLACE(METRICS, '_SRC', '') METRICS, 
  SRC, 
  TGT 
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
      * 
    FROM 
      CTE12
  ) src UNPIVOT (
    SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC)
  ) pvt1 UNPIVOT (
    TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT)
  ) pvt2

WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
